model_output.verdict: A product designer with a current cafe role and design work that needs more context.
write_up: Your resume points to product design, with work at Loop Fitness and Brightpath Studio before your current role at Ferry Street Coffee. It's common for design resumes to list deliverables without showing much about the problems behind them. Here, that makes it difficult for a recruiter to distinguish your work from other designers' in a pile.

The strongest model is the line about creating the app's first design system in Figma: it names a concrete deliverable, its place in the app, and the tool you used. Your current job accounts for your time, but your last dated product design role ended in February 2024, so a recruiter will look closely at what that work involved.

Let's start with the Loop Fitness booking flow. Add the problem you were designing for, then show what you contributed to releases and what you tested with members. Your portfolio can support those details, but your resume needs enough of the story to get a recruiter there.
